name: Bauernhof Haslingerhof
beschreibung: The traditional farm Bauernhof Haslingerhof is set in the municipality of Ebbs in Tyrol. Operated as a hospitable gasthof, it welcomes holidaymakers seeking an authentic Alpine escape. The property seamlessly blends working agricultural traditions with comfortable guest lodging. Located in the picturesque Lower Inn Valley, it serves as an excellent base for outdoor activities throughout the Alps. The in-house restaurant treats visitors to authentic Tyrolean delicacies, while accommodation options encompass various room categories reflecting classic regional charm.
